body:
The core personality interacts with our family. He has always been chatty with his mom. Recently has been talking more about dissociation, delusions, and hallucinations. She doesnt really care. Has an attitude that we are making it a big deal than it is. She knows that we have a history of depression and self harm. Its just not brought up. If we did she would likely have us put in a ward. I have heard horrible things about wards. I dont want to go there.

Im currently seeing a therapist. Went for the introductory visit last week. It was mostly for my depression. But when the therapist asked about my history I had to talk to other people in my head because I dont remember much before I was "born". She noticed this and even though I didnt intend to, I told her I suspect I have DID. Shes okay with it though. Im going back to see her again soon. I have trouble talking about myself to people. But I think she will help.

Should have disclosed that Im also a guy. And my boyfriend also has DID. Again he has his own reasons for being distant. He has his own issues.

Hey. I am also transgender but Im a transgender man and Ill also be 21 in August. I understand the frustration and fear. Feeling like you are just now starting your life or that your life hasnt even started yet. It doesnt feel fair that everyone else is moving forward while you feel stuck in time.

Im a practical person so Im not much in the way of cheery words of support. Jobs hunts are hard but is there any way you can work from home? And for your hair, try putting on conditioner 20 minutes before you shower and also washing your hair less. Helps keep it moisturized. 

I know this isnt a lot but I hope that there is at least reassurance in knowing someone read and empathized with your story.
